selection: The no_feedback and physical_feedback final snapshots from the same frozen parent/seed, in that order, with no reference-outcome selection.
budget_rationale: A separate reference budget, frozen before execution. Existing #137 regression chains consumed 202 and 290 SCF/gradient/Hessian primitives and approximately 1078 and 1463 seconds. Reuse its bounded 16-atom generated-candidate envelope: two serial 3300-second/3000-primitive attempts, with five-second recovery allowance each. Together these fit 2 GPU-hours, 16 CPU-core-hours and 1 GiB. No cap extension, automatic retry, training, additional parent or fixture search is authorized. Earlier xTB feedback and proxy costs remain recorded separately and are not erased.
claim_limits: This is a one-parent, one-seed development integration test, not an independent benchmark, method comparison or discovery-rate estimate.
The original source is a declared reactant endpoint; atom-map/graph auditing does not make it an independently prepared blind reactant.
Gas phase is the explicit modeling environment of the frozen live input, not a claim about the source geometry environment.
Guidance scores have no mapped chemical-event decoder. The planned product is null, and planned-event ID/realization remain null.
Only the unchanged independent reference chain can establish a channel; same endpoints, unresolved results, failures and exhausted budgets stay in the denominator and charged costs.

Raw coordinates, Hessians, paths and graph records remain on n2. Public reports retain hashes, outcomes, provenance, measured costs and replay checks. No TS discovery, barrier, mechanism, chemical-accuracy or model-superiority claim is made.
